verdict.rationale: Salesforce's official CLI ships `sf org create scratch` for spinning up separate scratch orgs and `sf apex run test` for running tests. Agentforce DevOps Center is pitched for building and testing apps and agents. This points to a first-party isolated test environment, but the evidence is only command names and marketing lines, with no description of how isolation from production works. missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox/scratch-org isolation from production data, sandbox provisioning or data-seeding details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Empower teams to build, test, and deploy AI-powered apps and agents securely at scale with Agentforce DevOps Center.
